questions.stem: 這些交換學生住在寄宿家庭，好讓自己更快學會中文、適應當地文化。
questions.answer: These exchange students live with host families so that they can learn Chinese and adapt to local culture faster.
accepted_answers: These exchange students stay with host families so that they can learn Chinese and adjust to the local culture more quickly.

questions.stem: 只要願意主動和同學聊天，要在國外交到朋友其實並不難。
questions.answer: As long as they are willing to chat with classmates first, it is actually not hard to make friends abroad.
accepted_answers: If they are willing to start conversations with classmates, it is not difficult to make friends in a foreign country.
As long as they are willing to talk with classmates first, making friends abroad is actually not difficult.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞

1.explanation_zh: 「好讓自己更快學會中文、適應當地文化」是住寄宿家庭的目的，可以用 so that + they + can + 原形動詞；因為兩個子句的主詞相同，也可以改用 in order to + 原形動詞。「學會中文」和「適應當地文化」是並列的兩個動作，can 後面的 learn 和 adapt 都用原形，形成平行結構。「住在寄宿家庭」是和寄宿家庭一起住，用 live with／stay with host families（複數）；「更快」用 faster 或 more quickly，放在句尾修飾兩個動作。
evidence: 好讓自己更快學會中文
學會中文、適應當地文化
1.strategy_zh: 看到「好讓…能…」「以便…」先想 so that＋子句；並列的動作要用同一種形式（同為原形或同為 V-ing）。
hints: 切成四段：這些交換學生住在寄宿家庭／好讓自己／更快／學會中文、適應當地文化
標的詞彙：exchange（交換）、host（host family 寄宿家庭）、adapt（適應，也可用 adjust）、culture（文化）、fast（快；比較級 faster）
句型框架：S + V … so that + S + can + VR₁ … and VR₂ … + faster

2.explanation_zh: 「只要…」是條件，用 as long as 或 if 引導，子句用現在式；中文省略主詞（指上一句的交換學生），英文要補 they are willing to …。「要在國外交到朋友並不難」真正的主詞是「在國外交到朋友」這個動作，英文習慣用虛主詞 it 放句首：it is not hard／difficult to make friends abroad，也可以用動名詞主詞 making friends abroad is not difficult。「主動」可以譯成 first、take the initiative to 或 start a conversation；abroad 是副詞，前面不加 in。
evidence: 要在國外交到朋友其實並不難
2.strategy_zh: 中文「要…很難／並不難」常是「動作當主詞」，先想 It is + adj. + to VR；「只要」是 as long as，不是 only if（唯有…才）。
hints: 切成四段：只要願意／主動和同學聊天／要在國外交到朋友／其實並不難
標的詞彙：willing（願意的）、chat（聊天，也可用 talk）、classmate（同學）、abroad（在國外）、hard（困難的，也可用 difficult）
句型框架：As long as + S + be willing to VR …, it is (not) + adj. + to VR …

target_words.zh: （寄宿家庭的）接待者；host family 寄宿家庭

patterns.frame: S + V … so that + S + can + VR …

patterns.label_zh: 平行結構（can 後面並列兩個原形動詞）
patterns.zh_trigger: 學會中文、適應當地文化

parts.zh: 這些交換學生住在寄宿家庭
accepted: These exchange students live with host families
These exchange students stay with host families
These exchange students live with local host families
These exchange students are staying with host families

common_errors.wrong: These exchange students live in host family
common_errors.right: These exchange students live with host families
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「住在寄宿家庭」是和寄宿家庭一起住，用 live with；學生不只一位，host families 要用複數。
「交換學生」是名詞修飾名詞 exchange student，不寫成 exchanging。

accepted: so that they will be able to

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「好讓自己…」表目的，用 so that + 主詞 + can + 原形動詞，不要把「讓」直譯成 let。

common_errors.wrong: so that they can to learn
common_errors.explanation_zh: 助動詞 can 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to。
fast 的比較級是 faster；要用副詞 quickly 時才寫 more quickly。

parts.zh: 學會中文、適應當地文化
accepted: learn Chinese and adapt to local culture
learn Chinese and adjust to the local culture
learn Chinese and adapt to the local culture
learn Chinese and get used to the local culture
learn Chinese and fit into the local culture

common_errors.wrong: learn Chinese and adapting to local culture
common_errors.right: learn Chinese and adapt to local culture
common_errors.explanation_zh: 平行結構：can 後面的兩個動作都用原形動詞（learn … and adapt …）。

common_errors.wrong: learn Chinese and adapt local culture
common_errors.right: learn Chinese and adapt to local culture
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「適應…」是 adapt to／adjust to，不能漏掉介系詞 to。

traps.literal_error: These exchange students live with host family so that they can learn Chinese and adapt to local culture faster.
traps.explanation_zh: 學生不只一位、各住不同家庭，host family 是可數名詞，要用複數 host families。

traps.literal_error: These exchange students live with host families so that they can learn Chinese and adapt to local culture more fast.
traps.explanation_zh: fast 的比較級是 faster；寫成 more fast 是字形錯誤（或改用副詞 more quickly）。

references: As long as they are willing to chat with classmates first, it is actually not hard to make friends abroad.
If they are willing to start conversations with classmates, it is not difficult to make friends in a foreign country.
As long as they are willing to talk with classmates first, making friends abroad is actually not difficult.

patterns.label_zh: 條件子句（只要…：as long as／if）
patterns.frame: As long as / If + S + V（現在式）, S + V …

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞
patterns.zh_trigger: 要在國外交到朋友其實並不難

accepted: As long as they are willing
So long as they are willing
As long as students are willing
As long as you are willing

common_errors.right: As long as they are willing
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文省略了主詞，英文的條件子句要補上主詞 they 和 be 動詞。

common_errors.wrong: As long as they are will to
common_errors.right: As long as they are willing to
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「願意」是形容詞 willing（be willing to + 原形動詞）；will 是助動詞，不能放在 be 後面。

accepted: to take the first step to chat with classmates
to take the initiative to talk to classmates
to chat with their classmates first
to chat with your classmates first

common_errors.explanation_zh: 同學不只一位，classmate 是可數名詞，要用複數。
active 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞；「主動」可以寫 first、take the initiative to 或 start a conversation。

accepted: to make friends in a foreign country
making friends in a foreign country

common_errors.explanation_zh: 動作當主詞要用動名詞 making，或改用虛主詞 it is … to make friends。
abroad 是副詞，前面不加介系詞 in。
difficulty 是名詞；be 動詞後面要用形容詞 difficult（或 hard）。
「並不難」前面沒有主詞時，英文要補虛主詞 it，不能讓句子以 is 開頭。

traps.literal_error: As long as willing to chat with classmates first, it is not hard to make friends abroad.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文的條件子句省略了主詞（指上一句的交換學生），英文子句一定要有主詞，要補上 they are willing …。

traps.literal_error: In foreign countries make friends actually is not hard.
traps.explanation_zh: 「在國外交到朋友」是動作當主詞，照中文語序會變成「介系詞片語＋原形動詞」當主詞；英文用虛主詞 It is not hard to make friends abroad，或動名詞 Making friends abroad is …。

2.restructuring_zh: 「要在國外交到朋友其實並不難」是動作當主詞，英文改用虛主詞 it 開頭：it is not hard to make friends abroad（也可用動名詞主詞 making friends abroad is …）；「只要願意…」沒有主詞，要補上 they。

1.translation: These exchange students live with host families so that they can learn Chinese more quickly and adapt to the local culture.
1.explanation_zh: 「好讓自己…」是目的，用 so that they can 引導；「住在寄宿家庭」譯成 live with host families 最自然；「更快」我理解為主要修飾學會中文，用 more quickly。

2.translation: As long as they are willing to take the initiative to chat with their classmates, it is actually not difficult for them to make friends abroad.
2.explanation_zh: 「只要…」用 As long as 表條件；「要…其實並不難」用 it is not difficult (for sb) to V 的虛主詞句型；中文沒有主詞，承接上句的交換學生用 they（也可用泛指的 you）；「主動」譯 take the initiative。

1.translation: These exchange students live with host families so that they can learn Chinese more quickly and adapt to the local culture.
1.explanation_zh: 「好讓……」表目的，用 so that 子句加 can；「更快」用 more quickly，「適應當地文化」用 adapt to the local culture。

2.translation: As long as you are willing to take the initiative to chat with your classmates, it is actually not difficult to make friends abroad.
2.explanation_zh: 「只要……」用 as long as；「主動」譯成 take the initiative；「要……並不難」用虛主詞 it is not difficult to V。
